description: Final V1 main (70%) + Combined P2 sleeve (30%) in CALM, tapering to 0% in CRISIS

rationale.lam_lo_0.30: CALM state: P2 gets 30% blend weight, V1 champion gets 70%
rationale.lam_max_0.35: Hard cap: P2 never exceeds 35% even with breadth/macro adjustments
rationale.add_breadth_0: Disabled: breadth weakness doesn't increase P2 (V1 handles defense)
rationale.add_macro_off_0: Disabled: macro risk-off doesn't increase P2 (V1 handles defense)
rationale.lam_hi_0.10: CRISIS state: P2 reduced to 10% (was 0%), V1 champion gets 90% — Soft Dampening
rationale.lam_mid_0.20: RISK_OFF state: P2 gets 20% blend weight (was 15%), V1 champion gets 80%
rationale.t2_up_0.40: hi entry requires 40%+ risk_rate (was 28%) — prevents premature CRISIS lockout
rationale.t2_down_0.35: hi exit at 35% risk_rate (was 26%) — tighter hysteresis band for faster recovery
